channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: The Fate of Bangladesh's Floating Schools
item.description: A creative solution to monsoon floods: floating schools that pick up children. Bangladesh pioneered this approach.

item.title: US Strikes Iranian Oil Tankers After Alleged Targeting of Navy Warships
item.description: The attack follows President Trump's comment downplaying the conflict with Iran as 'small potatoes'.

item.title: U.S.-Venezuela oil deal creates political dilemma for opposition
item.description: Venezuelan opposition members are uneasy about new oil agreements with the U.S., fearing that deals with the authoritarian government could weaken their stance.

item.title: Trump administration to start triumphal arch construction without final approvals
item.description: The Trump administration plans to break ground on a 250-foot triumphal arch in Washington, D.C., despite lacking final federal approval and amid ongoing reviews.
